question: Construction comes from a previous independent trial ending at t=0. A new pulse trial resets all stocks at t=0. Given the construction evidence, which fixed queue mechanisms are plausible and when would the new transient discriminate them?

observability.instrument: Synthetic delivered cumulative output from a NEW independent reset trial at t=0; construction has relative times [-8,0], and separately logged within-trial calibration times [0,8]. No held-out values supplied.
